notes: LOVE (love2d): a game is a .love zip, or on Windows a fused game.exe (love.exe with the .love appended) shipped beside love.dll, lua51.dll and SDL2.dll (https://love2d.org/wiki/Game_Distribution); an unpacked game is a folder whose main.lua runs and whose conf.lua defines love.conf (https://love2d.org/wiki/Config_Files). main.lua alone is not enough: other Lua runtimes use the same name, so the loose shape also needs love.conf. The LOVE version the game was written for is enrichment: love.dll's own version resource when the game ships the Windows runtime, else conf.lua's t.version. No enginehost plugin published yet.
